accessBoundary.readableOnlyAfter: both the primary and repeat raw-evidence manifests are written, hashed and verified

trustedStagingStep.why: Something must know which historical image becomes which opaque id, because something must copy it. That knowledge lives in the staging step, which runs BEFORE and OUTSIDE the acquisition process. The acquisition process receives only the staged directory.

assertionsUnderTest: acquisition input carries exactly four keys and no historical identifier or path
the map lives under post-freeze/, never under raw/, and never under the staged input directory
the map declares itself unmounted and unimported
every opaque id maps to exactly one historical case, with matching image hash and size
